name: Supra Trends Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 1987, Supra Trends Ltd
is engaged in Apparels, Footwear and incidental services.
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
Company is in the business of manufacturing, processing, marketing, distributing and acting as trader, C&F agent, distributor, representative, job worker and deals in all types of apparels, footwear, sportswear and other textiles goods. Company also deals in Paper and paper related products.
